title: Document the Windows x64 baseline checks
objective: Map XCL's existing build and tests to the results needed to keep Windows x64 working through the port. Review source and public CI only; do not run a game or candidate code.
acceptance: Cite the exact base revision, public Windows CI and the synthetic title tests
Separate hosted tests, skipped GPU or optional tests, and the evidence needed to show a visible frame on physical hardware
Do not treat upstream results or an untested title as VIE compatibility evidence
